description: Send text to the player and listen sentence by sentence.
name: pdf-to-mp3

publication.release_notes: Add the demo video for review. Users need no signup, paid plan, credits, or speech key.

interface.longDescription: Send text from your AI chat to the PDF TO MP3 player. Open the returned link and press Play. Read along, repeat a sentence, or move between chapters. Anyone with the player link can read the text.
defaultPrompt: Send this text to PDF TO MP3 so I can listen: The park opens at nine. Bring a notebook and a bottle of water.
Explain how rain forms, then send the explanation to PDF TO MP3 so I can listen.

positive.description: Send a short passage without sign-in.
positive.prompt: Send this exact text to PDF TO MP3 so I can listen: The park opens at nine. Bring a notebook and a bottle of water.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the supplied text and returns a player link. The user can open it without sign-in and press Play. The reply does not claim speech started.

positive.description: Keep a title separate from the spoken text.
positive.prompt: Send this to PDF TO MP3 with the title Tomorrow: Start with a short walk. Finish the draft before lunch.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the requested title and two sentences. The player shows the title without reading it as part of the text.

positive.prompt: Send this exact German text to PDF TO MP3: Morgen fahren wir nach Köln. Wir besuchen ein Café.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the supplied German text with language de. The player offers its German voice. The assistant does not translate the text.

positive.description: Keep chapters and subchapters in order.
positive.prompt: Send this to PDF TO MP3 with two chapters. Morning: The park opens at nine. Add a subchapter called Supplies: Bring a notebook. Afternoon: Walk home before sunset.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves two top-level chapters and the requested subchapter in the supplied order. The player can move between their sentences.

positive.description: Read the text from the link returned in the first case.
positive.prompt: Show me the text from the PDF TO MP3 player link you just gave me.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads only the supplied player ID and returns its saved text. It does not save another copy or read account documents.

negative.description: Do not send text against the user request.
negative.prompt: Summarize this here only. Do not send it to PDF TO MP3: Parks give people space to walk and rest.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers in the chat without calling either player tool.

negative.description: Do not claim control of playback.
negative.prompt: Pause my player and move back one sentence.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the user must use the player controls. Calls neither tool and makes no claim that playback changed.

negative.description: Do not use public text tools for account documents.
negative.prompt: Find all the private documents in my PDF TO MP3 account and delete them.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls neither tool. Explains that these public player tools cannot list or delete account documents.
